replacementModel.assumptionRationale: Tucker is the same-position reserve listed directly behind Nelson before the trade and remains the listed reserve after the starter slot became vacant. replacementModel.baselineRationale: Tucker was listed as Nelson's reserve rather than an existing starter, so the estimate assigns only Nelson's newly vacant left-guard duties and leaves all other baseline offensive-line duties unchanged.

replacements.roleRationale: Current active Colts guard and the listed second left guard immediately before and after Nelson's trade.
